evidence: High-resolution TEM images of /C24 41 nm thick GaN thin film deposited at 185 /C14 C showed small crystallites dispersed in an amorphous matrix. Film was found to be composed of small crystallites dispersed in an amorphous matrix [Fig. 4(b)]. A similar microstructure was also observed for the /C24 17 nm thick GaN thin film deposited at /C14 C (not shown here). GIXRD pattern of this sample [Fig. 4(c)] indicates an amorphous structure, with some implications of long-range order corresponding to the small crystallites that exist in the amorphous Ga-O-N matrix. Root-mean-square roughness (rms) of the /C24 17 nm thick film deposited at 250 /C14 C was measured as /C24 0.58 nm from a 1 lm /C2 1 lm scan area.
